title: Lenacapavir for HIV pre-exposure prophylaxis: NOT POOLABLE -- COMPARATOR
topic_state: NOT POOLABLE -- decided from the registrations
verification_basis: Both registrations read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18: conditions, arm groups with types, registered primary outcome measures, and posted results.

handbook_authority.handbook: Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions
handbook_authority.c62: 'Undertake (or display) a meta-analysis only if participants, interventions, comparisons and outcomes are judged to be sufficiently similar to ensure an answer that is clinically meaningful.'

primary.poolable_reason: TWO TRIALS, AND THEIR REGISTERED PRIMARY DOES NOT COMPARE LENACAPAVIR AGAINST A RANDOMISED ARM. Registrations read from ClinicalTrials.gov on 2026-08-18. In BOTH trials the registered primary is HIV-1 incidence per 100 person-years measured AGAINST A BACKGROUND INCIDENCE ESTIMATE derived from screened participants by a recent-infection testing algorithm -- PURPOSE 2 (NCT04925752) posts lenacapavir 0.103 against a background of 2.374 from 4634 screened; PURPOSE 1 (NCT04994509) posts lenacapavir 0.000 against a background of 2.407 from 8094 screened. A BACKGROUND RATE FROM SCREENED PARTICIPANTS IS AN EXTERNAL, NON-RANDOMISED COMPARATOR, and pooling two trials on their contrast with it would pool two non-randomised comparisons while presenting the result as a randomised one. AND WHERE THE TRIALS DO CARRY RANDOMISED ACTIVE ARMS, THOSE ARMS ARE DIFFERENT DRUGS: F/TDF in PURPOSE 2, F/TAF in PURPOSE 1. Different comparator, different question. AUTHORITY: MECIR Box 10.10.a C62 -- 'Undertake (or display) a meta-analysis only if participants, interventions, comparisons and outcomes are judged to be sufficiently similar to ensure an answer that is clinically meaningful.'

primary.what_this_verdict_does_not_establish: NOT that any trial here is poor -- each is registered and reports its own primary. NOT that the drug is ineffective; both lenacapavir trials in fact report striking results on their own terms. NOT that no poolable question exists in this area: only that the question this page's title asks cannot be answered by pooling the trials this page carries. THE CRITICISM IS OF THE POOLING AND OF NOTHING ELSE. The registry is a live document and this reads its contents on 2026-08-18; a later amendment could change it.
primary.the_zero_event_arm: PURPOSE 1 posts 0.000 HIV-1 events per 100 person-years in the lenacapavir arm. A zero-event arm requires a continuity correction or an exact method before any ratio can be formed, and house rules permit adding 0.5 ONLY where a cell is zero. THIS IS NOT WHY THE TOPIC CLOSES -- the comparator limb closes it -- but it is recorded because a future attempt to pool these two trials will meet it and should not discover it late.
primary.what_would_make_this_poolable: A pool of the RANDOMISED contrasts would need the two trials to share an active comparator, which they do not. A pool restricted to PURPOSE 2's F/TDF contrast is k=1 and is a single trial, not a synthesis.

risk_of_bias_verdict: Not assessed. A risk-of-bias assessment grades trials contributing to a pooled result; this page publishes none.
